resources.string: Sum of the rated power of all permanent loads, as declared to the SEC.
Optional: maximum demand from the load schedule. If empty, installed power is used. It cannot exceed it.
Dwellings need a service protection of at least 25 A (RIC N°10, clause 5.2).
Chooses the standard low-voltage service (RIC N°01, annex 1.3) that covers the installation demand.
Per clause 5.3, the service capacity may equal or be below the total installed power, never above it. Confirm the service type with the utility.
Rated power of the EVSE or charging point (e.g. 3.7 or 7.4 kW single-phase; 11 or 22 kW three-phase).
Number of identical chargers on the circuit or feeder.
Modes 1 and 2: household or industrial socket; mode 3: dedicated charger (wallbox); mode 4: DC fast charging.
Sets the demand factors of table N°15.1, which only apply with a load management system.
Without load management the demand factor is 1 (clause 9.4.1).
Optional: service power left for charging, to see the margin.
Sizes EV charging per RIC N°15: current and protection of each charger (table N°15.3), RCD by charging mode (clause 12.5) and total demand (table N°15.1).
